title: ATTRIBUTION
purpose: Scene-dialogue pass. Existing page beats remain authoritative. Existing anchor lines are preserved where useful; expanded dialogue turns each page into a playable scene rather than a beat card.

sceneDialogue.text: We know where. We know when.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIZER
sceneDialogue.text: And what am I supposed to close for?

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIZER
sceneDialogue.text: Then I can't empty three levels because someone expects something.
You can keep people away from the service corridor.
Pull every permit tied to Concourse 17 this morning.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CLERK
sceneDialogue.text: Suppression test. Ventilation cycle. Security readiness. All approved.
I'm not questioning any one authorization. I'm questioning why they're all happening together.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CLERK
sceneDialogue.text: Then I can't stop three lawful operations because you dislike the timing.
You brought us to a place and a time.
No device. No attacker. No failure mode.
Because the overpass wasn't an accident.
Then we stay until the time doesn't matter anymore.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CIVIC SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: ROUTINE SUPPRESSION TEST. NO EVACUATION REQUIRED.
Let go before it takes you with it.
Don't fight it. Get low. Hold what doesn't move.
There's a family under that door.
Give me five minutes and a clean sample.
Latch is local. Network won't release it.
When your bodies failed, people got hurt.

sceneDialogue.speaker: NEWS
sceneDialogue.text: For the second time in days, unauthorized Organosynthetic intervention has complicated a major civic emergency.

sceneDialogue.speaker: NEWS
sceneDialogue.text: Officials are reviewing whether specialized capability controls are necessary during future incidents.
Only one of them gets the headline.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: MUNICIPAL PROCUREMENT. CERTIFIED DELIVERY. STANDARD CHAIN OF CUSTODY.
Observed harm occurred without administrative violation.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC REPRESENTATIVE
sceneDialogue.text: The chemical selectively impaired Organics. That is an attack.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: The injured civilian and damaged partition are not under investigation. They happened.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Intent remains under investigation. Capability does not.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Mr. Mercer, what caused the initial instability?

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Did the Organics initiate the event?

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Did their destabilized capabilities also damage public infrastructure and contribute to injury?
They were targeted. They also saved people.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Should capability this consequential be unregulated?
You gave them the sentence they needed.
You gave them one truth after they asked the question they wanted.
And which line is on every feed?
That doesn't make the line false.
Those aren't always different until someone edits them.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORDER TEXT
sceneDialogue.text: Identity verification required for designated civic access.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORDER TEXT
sceneDialogue.text: Declared capability class required for hazard-capable persons.
Meaning it can take another value later.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ATTENDANT
sceneDialogue.text: Civilian transfer needs the new authorization.
I am not traveling as a function.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ATTENDANT
sceneDialogue.text: Then I can't clear the transfer.
You can. You are choosing not to.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
sceneDialogue.text: Yesterday they could stop me because they felt like it.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
sceneDialogue.text: Today they have to tell me why.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
sceneDialogue.text: I'm calling it something I can appeal.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
sceneDialogue.text: A rule I can challenge is better than a person I can't.
Only if the rule gets to exist.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
sceneDialogue.text: We have twelve thousand unresolved conflicts and sixty-three clerks.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
sceneDialogue.text: Reconcile records. Do not set policy.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC APPLICANT
sceneDialogue.text: I've never held a hazard permit.
Policy requires a relevant criterion. Population association is unsupported here.
Denial unsupported by governing criterion. Correcting.
Torque. Reflex latency. Hazard tolerance. Firmware dependence. Tissue response.
They wrote the heading for us.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ADMINISTRATOR
sceneDialogue.text: The Organic queue is down forty-one percent.
Compare current Organic capability thresholds against registered Human Citizen augmentation profiles.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: MULTIPLE HUMAN PROFILES EXCEED ORGANIC REVIEW THRESHOLDS.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: MERCER, JOHN. TORQUE / REFLEX / EMERGENCY OVERRIDE CAPABILITY.
